payload.reason: The evidence provides a comparison of the adaptively sparse Transformer method against standard softmax Transformers and other variants, highlighting performance differences and computational efficiency.

claims.text: The adaptively sparse Transformer improves interpretability and head diversity compared to standard softmax Transformers on machine translation tasks.
Models using α-entmax and 1.5-entmax achieve 75% and 90% of the training speed of the standard softmax model, respectively.
The adaptive α values allow the model to learn a combination of sparse and dense attention, which is more effective than fixed sparsity.
